newsitem.title: INDIA: India to increase air traffic by improving navigat.
newsitem.headline: India to increase air traffic by improving navigat.

text.p: There will be a big increase in air traffic and cargo movement through India thanks to a plan to update advanced air navigations systems across the country, officials said.

The Secretary, of the government's Department of Electronics, Shyamal Ghosh announced a national plan last week to improve satellite navigation systems across the country linked to airports. Officials said he also told a meeting on navigation the result would be a 10-fold increase in aviation safety and enhancement of air space capacity.

India would also expand its own production of navigation technology such as Ground Positioning Satellite receivers (GPS) he said. One Indian company has already won contracts against stiff international competition to furnish the Airports Authority of India with Automatic Dependent Surveillance (ADS) systems for Chennai (Madras) and Calcutta airports, Ghosh said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
